parole.testo: Borrowed from Tatar алмаз (almaz), from Persian الماس (almâs, “diamond”).

parole.significato: tub, bucket, basin, pail (broad, flat-bottomed vessel)
parole.testo: Inherited from Old East Slavic бадия (badija), via Tatar бадъя (bad-ya) from Persian بادیه (bâdye, “a capacious earthen vessel, in which wine is kept; a large deep jug, cup, bowl”), from Akkadian 𒁀𒋾𒌝 (baṭium, “vessel, basin, place to hold; tray, platter”), also found in Jewish Babylonian Aramaic בָּ
